page: Running Hono on Microsoft Azure Functions (V4 on Node.js 18+) using Azure Functions Adapter (@marplex/hono-azurefunc-adapter). Installation: Azure Functions Core Tools (@4) via brew or Microsoft documentation. Setup: func init --typescript creates TypeScript Node.js V4 project. Configure host.json to remove route prefix (/api default). Install hono and adapter packages. Create src/app.ts with Hono app export. Create src/functions/httpTrigger.ts with Azure Functions HTTP trigger using azureHonoHandler. Run locally: npm run start, access http://localhost:7071. Deploy: build with npm run build, deploy with func azure functionapp publish <AppName>. Questions: How do I set up Hono on Azure Functions? How do I remove route prefix? How do I configure the HTTP trigger? How do I deploy?

sections.manifest: Azure Functions Core Tools installation. macOS: brew tap azure/functions, brew install azure-functions-core-tools@4. Other OS: refer to Microsoft Learn documentation link. V4 required for Node.js 18+ support. Questions: How do I install Azure Functions Core Tools? Which version do I need?

Azure Functions project setup. Command: func init --typescript creates TypeScript V4 project. Configuration: host.json extensions.http.routePrefix set to "" (empty string). Default routePrefix is /api; must remove or prefix Hono routes. Install: @marplex/hono-azurefunc-adapter, hono packages. Questions: How do I initialize project? What's routePrefix? Why remove it?

Hello World application files. src/app.ts: Hono app with routes, export default app. src/functions/httpTrigger.ts: Azure Functions HTTP trigger. Imports: @azure/functions app, azureHonoHandler from adapter, Hono app. app.http() config: httpTrigger name, methods (GET, POST, DELETE, PUT), authLevel ('anonymous'), route ('{*proxy}'), handler (azureHonoHandler(honoApp.fetch)). Questions: What files do I need? How do I configure the HTTP trigger? What's azureHonoHandler?

Local development run. Commands: npm run start, yarn start, pnpm start, bun run start. Access: http://localhost:7071 in browser. Development server runs locally for testing. Questions: How do I run locally? What's the local URL?

Deployment to Azure Cloud. Prerequisites: create Azure resources (Microsoft Learn documentation). Build: npm run build, yarn build, pnpm build, bun run build compiles project. Deploy: func azure functionapp publish <YourFunctionAppName> publishes to Azure. Replace <YourFunctionAppName> with actual function app name. Questions: How do I build for deployment? How do I deploy to Azure? What resources do I need?
